summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 70 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 12 SP5)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 4.12.14-122.266 fixes various security issues

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-23191: ALSA: aloop: Fix racy access at PCM trigger (bsc#1258396).
- CVE-2026-23268: apparmor: fix unprivileged local user can do privileged policy management (bsc#1259859).
